description.narrative: The project will improve patients' and health workers' safety in hospitals in Mongolia. It will (i) improve the safety of blood transfusions, (ii) strengthen medical waste management, and (iii) prevent and control hospital acquired infections. It complements previous Asian Development Bank (ADB) initiatives in the health sector in Mongolia.

description.narrative: Improved patient and health worker safety in project-supported hospitals in Mongolia

The number of hospitals complying with national standards for hazardous solid and liquid medical waste treatment in 5 tertiary and 16 secondary project-supported hospitals increases from 0 to 14 for hazardous liquid medical waste. Progress/Status: Achieved. Reached 14 in 2018. Data Source: MOH and external audit report (GASI) Actual value:

By 2018, at least 90% of health care workers (82% women) in project-supported hospitals are vaccinated against hepatitis B (2011 baseline: 10%, sex, job tier, urban, and rural disaggregated). Progress/Status: 85% in 2017. (with 2 doses). Data Source: MOH statistics Actual value:

The number of hospitals complying with national standards for hazardous solid and liquid medical waste treatment in 5 tertiary and 16 secondary project-supported hospitals increases from 5 in 2012 to 19 in 2018 for solid hazardous medical waste. Progress/Status: Achieved. Reached 19 in 2018. Data Source: MOH and external audit report (GASI) Actual value:

At least 95% of blood collected for transfusions in 27 blood banks is screened with polymerase chain reaction, ELISA, or rapid test methods by 2018 from estimated 70% tested by ELISA and rapid test methods in 2010. Progress/Status: Reached 100% in 2018. Data Source: MOH and external audit report Actual value:

100% of suspected domestic COVID19 cases reported and investigated per national guidelines, with sex- and age disaggregated data (March 2020 baseline: 0%) Progress/Status: Achieved. 100% of suspected domestic COVID19 cases reported and investigated per national guidelines. As of 30 April 2022, since first COVID19 case was registered in Mongolia, total of 11,580,719 COVID19 tests done by PCR (72%) and rapid test (28%), of which 54% are women. Total of COVID 19 cases were 919,157, of which 1,231 are imported 1231 and locally transmitted cases are 917,878. The registered deaths due to COVID19 is 2,108, total of vaccinated people are 5,595,113 (cumulative). Healthcare workers' infection rate is 1.7% (15,640 cases) of all the confirmed cases, from which 32%are nurses and 26% are doctors. Data Source: MOH and external audit report (GASI) Base year: 2020 Baseline value: N
